The first interim dividend of 1.50p was paid on 28 August 2026 and a second interim dividend of 0.50p has been declared payable on 23 December 2026 (ex‑dividend 26 November; record 27 November). Since launch the Company will have distributed 102.95p per share in tax‑free dividends and the Board targets an annual dividend around 6% of prior year‑end NAV, noting distributions reduce NAV.
